snippet.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Rooftop Mayhem Available Now on Nex Playground!
snippet.description:
Get ready for rooftop action with Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Rooftop Mayhem! 🐢✨ 
You can join the Turtles in this all-new, active game only on Nex Playground. 
You’ll be able to:
🏃‍♂️Run through Brooklyn’s rooftops in this endless runner-style adventure
💥Battle iconic villains like Bebop and his mutant crew
🍕Level up your Turtles, unlock upgrades, and unleash Turtle Power!

With fast-paced gameplay, iconic boss battles, and the chance to save the city, it’s time to shell up and show your skills! Who’s ready for rooftop mayhem?

Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Rooftop Mayhem is available now on Nex Playground.

#playthatmovesyou #nexplayground
If you don’t want to miss out, subscribe for updates and exclusive gameplay previews.

💡Learn more about Nex Playground: https://www.nexplayground.com/
